sections.label: VCC corporate income tax treatment
sections.summary: A VCC is treated as a company for Corporate Income Tax, and an umbrella VCC files a single return with IRAS.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As announced by the Ministry of Finance in its Budget 2018 Statement, a VCC will be treated as a company for Corporate Income Tax purposes.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To ease the compliance burden, an umbrella VCC will only need to file a single Corporate Income Tax return with the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS), regardless of the number of sub-funds that it has.

sections.label: VCC tax incentive eligibility
sections.summary: VCCs are eligible for fund tax incentives under sections 13R and 13X of the Income Tax Act.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: VCCs will be eligible to benefit from tax incentives for funds under sections 13R and 13X of the Income Tax Act.

sections.label: VCC Act insolvency amendments
sections.summary: The VCC Act must be amended so the insolvency framework refers to the IRDA instead of the Companies Act.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As such, the VCC Act must be amended so that the insolvency framework for VCCs and their sub-funds will make reference to the relevant provisions in the IRDA instead of the Companies Act.

sections.label: VCC incorporation and operation
sections.summary: The VCC Act provides for the incorporation and operation of the VCC, a corporate structure for investment funds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: The VCC Act provides for the incorporation and operation of a new corporate structure, the VCC, which caters to the needs of investment funds.

sections.label: MAS estimated VCC jobs
sections.summary: MAS estimated the VCC framework could create over 1,000 new jobs for service providers in its first two years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: MAS has estimated that the VCC framework could create over 1,000 new jobs for service providers in the first two years of its introduction.

sections.label: VCC jobs created question
sections.summary: The question asks how many new jobs the VCC has created and whether it reached 1,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: How many new jobs have been created as a result of the VCC and has it reached the 1,000 mark?

sections.label: VCC framework and economic slowdown
sections.summary: The Minister is asked whether the VCC framework, with additional funds flowing into Singapore, can help cushion the economic slowdown.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Would the Minister be able to share whether this VCC framework, with the additional funds flowing into Singapore, can assist with cushioning the impact of the economic slowdown?

sections.label: VCC framework operation date
sections.summary: With these components in place, the VCC framework is anticipated to come into operation at the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: With these components in place the VCC framework is anticipated to come into operation at the end of this year.

sections.label: MAS pilot programme for VCCs
sections.summary: MAS will run a pilot programme for interested fund managers and service providers to familiarise the industry with the VCC framework and allow feedback on VCC registration.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: To familiarise the industry with the VCC framework and to allow fund managers to provide feedback on the registration process for VCCs, MAS will be running a pilot programme for interested fund managers and service providers.

sections.label: VCC curriculum, jobs and economy
sections.summary: MAS will study whether VCC modules are needed in tertiary curriculum after launch, and the framework could create over 1,000 new jobs for service providers in its first two years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: While there are currently no plans to introduce any modules relating to VCCs in the local tertiary curriculum, MAS will study whether this is necessary once the VCC framework is launched.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Mr Patrick Tay also asked about the number of jobs created and the impact of the VCC framework on the Singapore economy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: It is estimated that the VCC framework could create over 1,000 new jobs for service providers in the first two years of its introduction.
